subject: Telemetry divergence detected — request for IRP evidence & SIG/CAIQ mapping
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearpoint.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearpoint.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Observed telemetry divergence — request for IRP and evidence window

Hi Mina,

We observed an unexpected divergence in API telemetry between 08:40–08:52 PST this morning that affected a small subset of Clearpoint requests (approx 0.6% of calls). The anomaly looks like duplicate tokens and replays at the gateway layer — we're exploring on our side but would like Redwood's incident response support and artifacts.

Requesting:
- Confirmation of whether this is a Redwood-side incident and affected models/pools
- A copy of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) relevant sections for telemetry retention and evidence collection
- A short list of SIG/CAIQ controls mapping that cover log retention, telemetry exports, and access audit (we'll need it for our SOC reviewer)
- A secure transfer window (SFTP or presigned S3) to receive sanitized telemetry snippets for our triage team

We can share our sample telemetry snippet (attached) — it's redacted but includes trace ids. Can you confirm earliest ETA for the above? Our legal/compliance has tagged this as high priority for SOC review.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Senior SecOps Engineer
Clearpoint Financial

Attachment: clearpoint_telemetry_snippet.json (text)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearpoint.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observed telemetry divergence — request for IRP and evidence window

Alex —

Thanks for the heads-up and for the sample. We're treating this as an incident priority. Quick notes and next steps:

1) Initial triage: Jonas and Neha are on the investigation to determine scope and root cause. Jonas will confirm whether any serving pools or model variants show anomalous token duplication.

2) Evidence/IRP: I'm attaching our IRP excerpt (runbook_redwood_irp_v1.pdf) that covers telemetry retention, secure transfer, and evidence minimization. We also have a SIG->CAIQ mapping spreadsheet but need to confirm a redaction-friendly extract for you — Marissa will own that.

3) Transfer window: We can provision a time-bound presigned S3 bucket at s3://redwood-incident-transfer/clearpoint-20261125/ with objects TTL of 7 days. If SFTP is strictly required, we can open an SFTP account temporarily; please confirm preference.

4) SLA/next update: We'll aim to provide the IRP excerpt + initial SIG mapping within 3 hours and an evidence bundle (sanitized logs) within 6 hours if scope is limited. If wider scope, we'll propose cadence.

I'll follow up with an internal message to assign owners and collect the artifacts you need.

-Mina
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachment: runbook_redwood_irp_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearpoint.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observed telemetry divergence — SIG/CAIQ mapping and transfer details

Alex,

Following Mina's note: attached is a curated SIG->CAIQ mapping (excerpted) that specifically highlights controls for:
- Telemetry export and retention (SIG TDE-1 / CAIQ: Trans Logging controls)
- Evidence sanitization and redaction guidance
- Temporary access and audit trail expectations

Transfer options:
- Presigned S3 (recommended): I'll create keys scoped to clearpoint-20261125 with object-level logging. Link will be shared via a separate signed message.
- SFTP: possible but requires onboarding form from your team. If you pick S3, reply with preferred encryption-at-rest key type (AWS-managed or customer-managed KMS key ARN).

Attachments included (sanitized):
- s3_forensics_manifest.csv — names and hashes of artifacts we'll upload
- runbook_redwood_irp_v1.pdf — IRP excerpt (same as Mina attached)

Next steps: confirm S3 vs SFTP and KMS choice. We'll push the first artifact set within ~2 hours of confirmation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Security Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: s3_forensics_manifest.csv (csv)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearpoint.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observed telemetry divergence — confirmation of evidence handoff window

Alex — quick confirm:

- We will provision presigned S3 path s3://redwood-incident-transfer/clearpoint-20261125/; encryption: AWS-managed KMS (aws/s3)
- We'll upload the initial sanitized bundle (manifest + 3 artifacts) by 16:30 PST today
- Audit trail will be retained and we'll provide signed object hashes; redaction notes will accompany the bundle
- Internal postmortem: We'll share the summary (non-sensitive) via Drive link and provide SIG/CAIQ full mapping for your SOC team within 48 hours

If anything changes on your side (you need SFTP or a narrower window), flag immediately. Otherwise I'll mark this as 'handoff scheduled' and circle back after upload.

-Mina
